orchestration_note: Tasks assigned to 'team-lead' are orchestration actions (team formation, routing decisions, verification checkpoints). They do NOT violate the delegation-only principle. Implementation work (code, docs, tests, commits) is ALWAYS delegated to teammates.

task_tracker.enforcement: ⛔ MANDATORY: The team lead MUST create INDIVIDUAL task tracker entries for EACH task listed below using TaskCreate, and update EACH with TaskUpdate as they complete. Clubbing multiple tasks into a single entry, skipping task registration, or deferring registration is a PROTOCOL VIOLATION that breaks phase visibility, dependency tracking, and stage ordering. Failure to register tasks individually WILL cause downstream phase gates to lose ordering context and review stages to miss acceptance criteria. Register each task BEFORE starting it, mark it in_progress when work begins, and completed when done. NO EXCEPTIONS.
task_tracker.on_phase_enter: TaskCreate(subject, description, activeForm) — one entry for this phase
task_tracker.per_task: TaskCreate one entry per task ID in tasks[] below (PF1-TSK-01, PF1-TSK-02, PF1-TSK-03)
task_tracker.on_task_complete: TaskUpdate status=completed for each task entry as it finishes
task_tracker.on_phase_complete: TaskUpdate status=completed for the phase entry
